meta.method: two independent full-prompt extractions (different models) reconciled against a mechanical inventory of every atom in the 316 regression goldens, the e2e harness and the seeded rules; 17 field disagreements adjudicated by the orchestrator and marked _adjudicated
meta.revision_note: re-pinned 2026-07-29 after the M1 v4/v5 fix batch: gap-0023 nominalization scope, noun-modifier exposure, stative-intransitive Experiencer, past-perfect Before scope + seal carve-out. No operator added, removed or re-typed. Goldens 326.

field_semantics.class: core-link | role | status | property-constructor | operator | discourse | surface-record | engine
field_semantics.opaque: stored and matched verbatim; do NOT decompose. Star decomposition treats the atom as one node.
field_semantics.bridged: a seeded rule fires FROM this head. Independent of `opaque` — 11 heads are both.
field_semantics.frozen: mining may NOT propose a rule rewriting this operator away. Derived mechanically: head matched by a seeded rule premise, or by a documented query pattern, or core/engine. Open-class heads are never frozen — they are what consolidation is for.
field_semantics.frozen_false_WARNING: `frozen: false` is NOT a licence to merge. This is a COMPATIBILITY gate only — it says rewriting the head breaks no existing seeded rule or query pattern, not that a merge is meaning-preserving. Semantic safety is M4's job (rule precision + the zero negative-control-merge hard gate). Several unfrozen heads (Must, Future, Probably, Instrument, Manner) are unfrozen only because no current query happens to exercise them.
field_semantics.variadic: argument count varies; `arities` records the attested range, not a fixed signature.
field_semantics.attested: occurrence counts from the regression corpus; n=0 means declared but never exercised.

:.gloss: Statement wrapper: proof-name, logical content, truth value.

attested.note: wrapper stripped by the extractor; present on every asserted atom

:.notes: `(: <proof_name> <content> (STV s c))`. Proof-name is snake_case in statements, `$prf` in queries. Absent from the mechanical empirical inventory because the extractor strips the wrapper; it is present on every golden atom.

Again.gloss: Repetitive/restitutive presupposition: a prior same-type event happened.
Again.notes: Opaque presupposition tag on the event; the presupposed prior/expected event is never asserted. Defined under `### Aspectual particles`.

Agent.gloss: Volitional doer / subject of an action.
Agent.notes: Also a motion/self-propelled intransitive subject; a collective predicate takes several Agent atoms on one event.

Already.gloss: The eventuality happened earlier than expected.
Already.notes: Opaque presupposition tag on the event; the presupposed prior/expected event is never asserted. Defined under `### Aspectual particles`.

Also.section: ## Focus particles & clefts (only / even / also / it-clefts)
Also.gloss: Additive focus particle ('also / too / as well').
Also.notes: `(<Op> <focused-filler> <event>)`; the prejacent is asserted normally. Filler is the focused constituent's symbol, or the verb-class lemma for VP focus. Never emit an exclusion rule or assert the presupposition.

Although.section: ## Inter-clause connectives (because / so / although / but / purpose "to")
Although.notes: Surface-faithful binary connective: main/matrix clause first, subordinate second; fronting changes nothing. The connective class is deliberately OPEN-ENDED ("there is no closed causal lexicon" — the surface word IS the data, multiword connectives CamelCase-join); this entry is one of the heads the prompt literally names. STV (1.0 0.99). Emitted only for an explicit non-temporal connective — temporal connectives get none, and a defeasible-exception 'but/except/unless' gets none. States no reason — no seeded bridge to ReasonFor.

And.gloss: Conjunction bundle; one fact, one truth value.
And.notes: Three jobs: the strength-0 wrapper of a negated/denied event (`### Negation (events)`), the multi-atom sealing term (*Core patterns*), and the query join over a shared event variable (*Queries*).

Before.gloss: Canonical ordering: the first eventuality precedes the second.
Before.notes: 'after' swaps the arguments. Transitivity and calendar-derived orderings are seeded.

BeforeBy.gloss: Measured temporal gap between two eventualities.
BeforeBy.notes: The MoreBy of time; anchors on the reserved symbol `now` for 'ago / from now'. Seeded rules derive Before and add gaps along a chain.

The connective class is deliberately OPEN-ENDED ("there is no closed causal lexicon" — the surface word IS the data, multiword connectives CamelCase-join); this entry is one of the heads the prompt literally names. States no reason — no seeded bridge to ReasonFor.

Can.gloss: A specific subject's capability on this event.
Can.notes: A capability generic over a KIND is the reified property `(Inheritance kind (can v))` instead — an individual capability question unions the two storages. Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Cardinality.gloss: Exact size of a group (a point value, native integer).
Cardinality.notes: Does not claim world-closure; 'exactly three' emits the same atom.

CardinalityAtLeast.gloss: Lower bound on a group's size.

CardinalityAtMost.gloss: Upper bound on a group's size.

CardinalityPhrase.gloss: Records a vague count phrase on a group ('several', 'dozens').
CardinalityPhrase.notes: Normalized to the canonical lexicon string; seeded rules map it to a numeric bound. Emit no number yourself.

Cleft.section: ## Focus particles & clefts (only / even / also / it-clefts)
Cleft.notes: `(<Op> <focused-filler> <event>)`; the prejacent is asserted normally. Filler is the focused constituent's symbol, or the verb-class lemma for VP focus. Never emit an exclusion rule or assert the presupposition.

CoAgent.gloss: Animate co-participant named by a comitative phrase ('with John').
CoAgent.notes: A means, not a participant, is Instrument instead.

Compute.gloss: Hard-numeric arithmetic/comparison test on bound integers.
Compute.notes: `(Compute > ($n k) -> true)`. Arg1 = operator symbol (> < >= <= == + - * /), arg2 = argument tuple, arg3 = the literal `->` marker, arg4 = `true`/`false` for a test or a `$`-var receiving a computed value. Introduced under `### Counting questions`; reused in Measures, Time and reciprocal distinctness guards.

Conclusions.gloss: Variadic consequent conjunct list of an Implication.

ConditionalProperty.gloss: A kind has a property only under a stated condition.
ConditionalProperty.notes: Do not also assert the bare Inheritance; seeded `cond_prop` hands the property to a member in the condition state.

Counterfactual.section: ## Inter-clause connectives (because / so / although / but / purpose "to")
Counterfactual.gloss: Sealed subjunctive conditional: antecedent and consequent, neither asserted.
Counterfactual.notes: Plus the antecedent as a separate strength-0.0 bundle (the 'it didn't happen' presupposition); the consequent is never asserted. 'unless / if not X' is explicitly NOT yet supported. Defined under `### Counterfactual conditionals`.

Day.notes: Structured Time term — one atom per granularity actually stated; also fills TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost/Start/End slots.

Degree.gloss: Intensity level of a property on an entity.
Degree.notes: Level is the lemmatized surface adverb (very/slightly/…), a fixed construction marker (`excessive`/`sufficient`/`insufficient`), or a `(forKind <class>)` term. For a quantity the scale slot is the literal `quantity`. The positive property is asserted alongside — except in the forKind comparison-class case.

The connective class is deliberately OPEN-ENDED ("there is no closed causal lexicon" — the surface word IS the data, multiword connectives CamelCase-join); this entry is one of the heads the prompt literally names. STV (1.0 0.99). Emitted only for an explicit non-temporal connective — temporal connectives get none, and a defeasible-exception 'but/except/unless' gets none. States no reason — no seeded bridge to ReasonFor.

Directive.gloss: Seals a positive imperative's commanded eventuality.
Directive.notes: No tense/occurrence asserted, no addressee referent minted; a vocative addressee goes inside as Agent. Defined under `### Imperatives`.

During.gloss: The inner eventuality is nested inside the outer one.
During.notes: Also ties a whenever-rule's per-occurrence response event to its trigger.

End.gloss: Interval end point of an eventuality.
End.notes: A 'when did X stop' question unions the interval End branch with a reified stop-event branch.

Even.section: ## Focus particles & clefts (only / even / also / it-clefts)
Even.notes: `(<Op> <focused-filler> <event>)`; the prejacent is asserted normally. Filler is the focused constituent's symbol, or the verb-class lemma for VP focus. Never emit an exclusion rule or assert the presupposition.

EvenThough.section: ## Inter-clause connectives (because / so / although / but / purpose "to")
EvenThough.notes: Surface-faithful binary connective: main/matrix clause first, subordinate second; fronting changes nothing. The connective class is deliberately OPEN-ENDED ("there is no closed causal lexicon" — the surface word IS the data, multiword connectives CamelCase-join); this entry is one of the heads the prompt literally names. STV (1.0 0.99). Emitted only for an explicit non-temporal connective — temporal connectives get none, and a defeasible-exception 'but/except/unless' gets none. States no reason — no seeded bridge to ReasonFor.

Every.gloss: Periodic recurrence: the event happens every n units.
Every.notes: A named calendar slot also implies its cycle, e.g. `(Every e 1 week)` for 'every Monday'. Unions with TimesPer on a 'how often' question.

Experiencer.gloss: Subject of a stative predication — psych state or predicate-adjective state.

FoldAll.gloss: Aggregate fold across all pattern matches (e.g. sum of cardinalities).
FoldAll.notes: `(FoldAll <pattern> <value> <init> <fold-fn> -> $tot)`; emit only when the question asks for an explicit aggregate total. NOT present in the supplied empirical inventory, but I verified it IS attested at regression/e2e_regression.py:251 — the extractor appears to have missed it (no `(: …)` wrapper).

Forbid.gloss: Seals a negative imperative's forbidden eventuality.

Fraction.gloss: Exact fraction / percentage term, numerator over denominator.

Future.notes: Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Goal.notes: Also carries a motion resultative's endpoint ('into the box').

GreaterThan.gloss: Graded P(value > N) over a distribution magnitude.
GreaterThan.notes: Also compares two distributions `(GreaterThan $da $db)`. The distribution half of the exact-vs-distribution dual-storage union; `Compute` is the hard-integer half.

GroupOf.gloss: The members of this group individual are of that kind.
GroupOf.notes: The group is an individual, never a class filler; a collective noun already names the kind and needs no GroupOf.

Holder.gloss: Subject of a possession/relational state only (own, have, lack).
Holder.notes: A bare property state is Experiencer, never Holder; the seeded poss_have/poss_own bridge keys off Holder.

Hour.notes: Structured Time term — one atom per granularity actually stated; also fills TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost/Start/End slots.

Implication.gloss: Inference rule: a Premises term implies a Conclusions term.
Implication.notes: Also used for exclusivity rules (strength 0.0) under Exclusive-or, and for comparative correlatives.

InOrderTo.section: ## Inter-clause connectives (because / so / although / but / purpose "to")
InOrderTo.notes: Surface-faithful binary connective: main/matrix clause first, subordinate second; fronting changes nothing. The connective class is deliberately OPEN-ENDED ("there is no closed causal lexicon" — the surface word IS the data, multiword connectives CamelCase-join); this entry is one of the heads the prompt literally names. STV (1.0 0.99). Emitted only for an explicit non-temporal connective — temporal connectives get none, and a defeasible-exception 'but/except/unless' gets none. Purpose heads bridge to PurposeOf, which chains into ReasonFor. `To` is NOT used for a degree-governed infinitive ('too/enough ADJ to V').

Inheritance.gloss: A class/property is a subclass of another class/property.
Inheritance.notes: Second argument may be a property or a reified property term `(can|obligated|permitted <action>)`; also `(Inheritance <compound> <head-noun>)` for decomposition.

Instrument.gloss: The means an action is performed by ('with a knife').
Instrument.notes: A tool or substance, never a person.

KindProperty.gloss: Non-distributing property of a kind/population as a whole.
KindProperty.notes: For properties no single instance can hold (extinct, widespread); contrasts with Inheritance, which distributes.

Manner.notes: Declared in the obliques list; aspectual particles must NOT be stuffed into Manner.

Measure.gloss: Puts a magnitude and unit on an entity's dimension.
Measure.notes: Scale = the surface dimension (stated adjective, else the dimension noun: weight/price/temperature/duration). Magnitude may be a `(ParticleFromNormal X σ)` distribution. Does not entail the positive; tense wraps it.

Member.gloss: An individual belongs to a class or holds a property.
Member.notes: Also the event class `(Member <event> <verb-lemma>)`, adjectival predication `(Member x tall)`, and an inherited reified property `(Member x (can fly))`.

Might.notes: Confidence 0.9 (an inference, not a flat fact). Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Minute.notes: Structured Time term — one atom per granularity actually stated; also fills TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost/Start/End slots.

Month.notes: Structured Time term — one atom per granularity actually stated; also fills TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost/Start/End slots.

MonthNumber.gloss: Seeded lexicon fact giving a month name its ordinal number.
MonthNumber.notes: Never emitted by the translator; joined in QUERIES to order/threshold months.

More.gloss: X exceeds Y on a scale (reified comparative ordering).
More.notes: Scale is the lemmatized surface adjective/adverb; 'less' swaps the pair, an antonym keeps its surface pole. Comparanda may be individuals, events (adverbial comparatives) or groups (clausal quantity comparatives). Does not entail the positive.

MoreBy.gloss: Comparative with a measured gap: X exceeds Y by n units.
MoreBy.notes: Magnitude may be a `(ParticleFromNormal …)` distribution; unit may be a compound rate unit. Seeded rules derive the plain More and add gaps along a chain.

Most.gloss: Superlative: X is the most ADJ member of a class.
Most.notes: Emitted with X's `(Member X <class>)`; bare 'the tallest' defaults the class to `person`.

Must.notes: Confidence 0.9; the deontic sense of 'must' is Obligated instead. Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Name.gloss: Records a named individual's surface name string.
Name.notes: Emitted once per referent; a query binds a named individual via `(Name $x "…")` rather than a hard-coded symbol. Never emitted by a question.

Obligated.gloss: Deontic obligation on a specific act.
Obligated.notes: Strength 0.7 for weak 'should / ought'. A kind-level norm uses `(obligated <action>)` instead. Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Ongoing.notes: Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Only.section: ## Focus particles & clefts (only / even / also / it-clefts)
Only.notes: `(<Op> <focused-filler> <event>)`; the prejacent is asserted normally. Filler is the focused constituent's symbol, or the verb-class lemma for VP focus. Never emit an exclusion rule or assert the presupposition.

Or.gloss: Inclusive disjunction: at least one disjunct holds, unspecified which.
Or.notes: Declared `(Or <d1> <d2> …)` — variadic; each disjunct is an atom or an `(And …)` bundle. Scope as narrowly as possible; never assert a disjunct on its own.

Ordinal.gloss: The entity's rank n on an ordering scale.
Ordinal.notes: Rank may be the symbol `last` instead of an integer; scale is the associated event verb-lemma or an explicit '-est' dimension. Rank 1 is the Most special case.

PartOf.section: ## Compound concepts — prefer single-word, else decompose
PartOf.gloss: Part/component (or named member) of a whole.
PartOf.notes: Introduced for possessor-part compounds ('car engine'); reused for group membership (Coordination), mass partitives (Partitives), and as the range predicate of a group distribution rule (Quantifiers).

ParticleFromNormal.gloss: Approximate magnitude as a normal distribution: mean and sigma.
ParticleFromNormal.notes: σ ≈ 10% of X for a tight hedge, ≈ 20% for a loose one; also used inside an `(Hour …)` term for an approximate clock time and inside MoreBy for an approximate gap.

Past.notes: Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Patient.gloss: Object the action creates, destroys, consumes or physically changes.
Patient.notes: Also a change-of-state intransitive subject and a non-volitional natural-process subject.

Permitted.gloss: Deontic permission on a specific act.
Permitted.notes: A prohibition is `(Permitted e)` at strength 0.0, never a negated Obligated. Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

Possession.section: ## Compound concepts — prefer single-word, else decompose
Possession.notes: Possessed first. Never an `own` event for a static genitive; a part/component takes PartOf instead. Possession questions ALWAYS query this form — seeded poss_have/poss_own derive it from a verbal have/own event.

Premises.gloss: Variadic antecedent conjunct list of an Implication.

Probably.notes: Confidence 0.9. Over a copular clause the status head wraps the categorical atom as one term argument: `(Past (Member alice happy))`.

ProportionOf.gloss: The portion's proportion of a definite whole.
ProportionOf.notes: Level is polymorphic: a vague symbol (most/half/some/few/none) or a `(Fraction n d)` term.

PurposeOf.gloss: Canonical ask-relation: purpose/goal of a focus event.
PurposeOf.notes: QUERY-ONLY, like ReasonFor; derived from the purpose heads To / InOrderTo / SoAsTo.

QuantifierPhrase.gloss: Records the surface quantifier word beside the strength it set.
QuantifierPhrase.notes: Copular form `(QuantifierPhrase <subject> <predicate> "<word>")`; verbal form `(QuantifierPhrase <kind> <verb-lemma> "<word>")` beside the distributing rule. Emitted ONLY when a quantifier word is actually present — its absence marks a bare generic.

Question.gloss: Seals an embedded constituent (wh-) question with its wh-word.
Question.notes: The wh-word (who/what/where/when/how) is reused as the gap filler inside the sealed content; the gap must not leak as an existential.

ReasonFor.gloss: Canonical ask-relation: reason for a focus event.
ReasonFor.notes: QUERY-ONLY: appears only in queries and seeded rules, never in translated statements. Derived by seeded bridge rules from every reason-bearing surface head; PurposeOf chains into it.

RestOf.gloss: Flags a portion as the remainder of a definite whole.
RestOf.notes: Emitted alongside the ordinary partitive SubsetOf/PartOf portion.

Result.gloss: Links an event to the reified result state it caused.
Result.notes: State resultatives only — a motion result carries no Result atom (Source/Goal IS the result); omit when it is unclear whether a state is caused or merely concurrent. Defined under `### Resultatives & secondary predicates`.

STV.gloss: Truth value: strength and confidence, both in [0,1].
STV.notes: Confidence is never 1.0; in a query the whole TV is `$tv`, or pinned `(STV 0.0 $conf)`.

SameDegree.gloss: Equative: X is as ADJ as Y.

ScaleOpposite.gloss: Links the two poles of one gradable dimension.
ScaleOpposite.notes: Named in the prompt as a SEEDED lexicon — the translator emits neither ScaleOpposite nor the flipped comparative atom. Included for completeness; empirically it appears only in seeded_rules.metta.

Source.notes: Also carries a motion resultative's starting point ('off the counter').

Start.gloss: Interval start point of an eventuality.

Still.gloss: Continuative: the eventuality still holds (positive counterpart of cessation).
Still.notes: Opaque presupposition tag on the event; the presupposed prior/expected event is never asserted. Defined under `### Aspectual particles`.

SubsetOf.gloss: A quantified subset group of a definite superset group.
SubsetOf.notes: Count/plural partitives only; a mass whole uses PartOf instead. Defined under `### Partitives`.

Symmetric.gloss: Tags a relation head as mutual by meaning.
Symmetric.notes: Argument is the lemmatized UpperCamelCase relation head; seeded `sym_rel` derives the reverse direction. A group-rule reciprocal needs NO tag.

Theme.gloss: Object acquired, transferred, moved, possessed, perceived or evaluated unchanged.
Theme.notes: Also carries a sealed proposition for propositional attitudes / embedded questions, and the reified caused event of a periphrastic causative. Default role when the change test is unclear.

Time.gloss: Locates an eventuality at a time point or recurrence slot.
Time.notes: Filler is a structured calendar/clock term `(Year …)`/`(Month …)`/`(Day …)`/`(Weekday …)`/`(Hour …)`/`(Minute …)`, or a bare deictic/day-part symbol (`yesterday`, `morning`). Listed as an oblique role under `### Thematic roles`; fully specified under the Time section.

TimeAtLeast.notes: Strict 'after' drops the boundary point; any granularity term.

TimeAtMost.notes: Strict 'before' drops the boundary point; 'by T' deadlines map here.

TimesAs.gloss: Multiplicative comparative: X is <factor> times as ADJ as Y.
TimesAs.notes: twice→2, half→0.5. Seeded rules derive the ordering and, given Y's measure, X's measure.

TimesPer.gloss: Rate recurrence: n times per unit.

The connective class is deliberately OPEN-ENDED ("there is no closed causal lexicon" — the surface word IS the data, multiword connectives CamelCase-join); this entry is one of the heads the prompt literally names. Purpose heads bridge to PurposeOf, which chains into ReasonFor. `To` is NOT used for a degree-governed infinitive ('too/enough ADJ to V').

Weekday.notes: Structured Time term — one atom per granularity actually stated; also fills TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost/Start/End slots.

WeekdayNumber.gloss: Seeded lexicon fact giving a weekday name its number (monday=1).
WeekdayNumber.notes: Never emitted by the translator; joined in QUERIES to order/threshold weekdays.

Whether.gloss: Seals an embedded polar question under the matrix verb's Theme.
Whether.notes: Must not become `(Might P)`; the content is never asserted. Defined under `### Embedded questions`.

Xor.gloss: Exclusive disjunction: exactly one of two disjuncts holds.
Xor.notes: Atomic disjuncts additionally get two strength-0.0 `Implication` rule-out rules; complex/event disjuncts get the `Xor` label only. n-ary XOR is an open backlog item.

Year.notes: Structured Time term — one atom per granularity actually stated; also fills TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost/Start/End slots.

Yet.gloss: NPI 'yet': expected but not yet — under negation or a question.
Yet.notes: HEAD COLLISION: two unrelated senses share this symbol, disambiguated only by arity. Operator identity for mining is (name, arity), not name.

senses.gloss: NPI 'yet': expected but not yet, always under negation or a question

can.gloss: Builds the reified capability property term from a verb lemma.
can.notes: Lowercase by the casing exception — distinguishes it from the status head `Can`. Used by capability generics, agent-nominalizations and defeasible exceptions.

forKind.gloss: Comparison-class marker: ADJ relative to the norm for a kind.
forKind.notes: The one deliberate camelCase symbol; appears only in a Degree level slot.

obligated.gloss: Builds the reified obligation property term from an action.
obligated.notes: Action may be a compound `verb_object` symbol, which is then decomposed (genus + Patient). Defined under 'Deontic norms & prohibitions over a kind'.

permitted.gloss: Builds the reified permission property term from an action.
permitted.notes: A kind-level prohibition is this term at strength 0.0.

open_class.policy: Lexical relation heads the prompt licenses generically rather than enumerating: kind-level relations, symmetric/reciprocal relations, nominalization relations. They cannot be checked by name — the validator checks position and arity only. Never frozen: these are the primary consolidation targets.
positions: head of a kind-level relation atom, e.g. (Carry mosquito malaria)
head of a symmetric relation atom accompanied by (Symmetric <head>)
head of a nominalization kind-relation, e.g. (Build dam_builder dam)
skolem-function head (sk_<verb>) in a scope construction, e.g. (sk_y $x)

declared_but_unattested.note: Declared in prompt.txt but exercised by no regression golden, e2e case or seeded rule. These are regression-coverage gaps, not errors.
